Poder de ataque cuerpo a cuerpo de Estre.habilidad: Star and Stripe: Melee Attack Power+
Poder de ataque cuerpo a cuerpo de Estre.descripcion: Increases damage dealt with Melee Attacks.

Rescate Civil Veloz.descripcion: For a set amount of time after the battle starts, shortens the time required to rescue/threaten a civilian.
Rescate Civil Veloz.subir_nivel: Level up to increase effect time.

Localizador de Kota.descripcion: Gambling Tuning. You have a small chance to find Kota if it wasn't already taken. Huge value, but it will rarely work in ranked.
Localizador de Kota.subir_nivel: Level up to reduce activation time.

Carga PU Aplastante.descripcion: Dealing a K.O. grants you up to 20% of your PU gauge. This tune allows you to activate your PU significantly faster and, potentially, use it multiple times in a single match.
Carga PU Aplastante.subir_nivel: Level up to increase charge amount.

Turbo PU.descripcion: When you down an opponent, fills your PU/PC Meter and allows wall-running for a set time.
Turbo PU.subir_nivel: Level up to increase effect duration.

Rapidez de Venganza.descripcion: When your Guard breaks, increases Movement Speed and allows wall-running for a set time.
Rapidez de Venganza.subir_nivel: Level up to increase effect duration.

Salto Espacial.descripcion: For a set time after battle starts, vertical jumps are enhanced.
Salto Espacial.subir_nivel: Level up to increase effect duration.

Resistir Calor.subir_nivel: Level up to reduce activation time.

Resistir Frío.subir_nivel: Level up to reduce activation time.

Corredor de Muros.descripcion: Incredibly strong tune that gives you an ability to run up walls. This is a real saving grace for all non-mobility characters, but still works fine for pretty much everyone in the game.
Corredor de Muros.subir_nivel: Level up to increase effect duration.

Camuflaje.descripcion: Turns you invisible for a set time when an ally falls.
Camuflaje.subir_nivel: Level up to increase effect duration.

Resistir Descarga.subir_nivel: Level up to reduce activation time.

Electrificación.descripcion: Electrifies enemies for a set time when you break their Guard.
Electrificación.subir_nivel: Level up to increase effect duration.

Indestructible.descripcion: When you down an opponent, allows you to resist knockback from enemy attacks for a set time.
Indestructible.subir_nivel: Level up to increase effect duration.

Fuerza de Voluntad.descripcion: Leaves you at 1 HP after receiving a fatal hit.
Fuerza de Voluntad.subir_nivel: Level up to reduce activation time.

Análisis de Campo.descripcion: Shows the location of the next Safe Zone.
Análisis de Campo.subir_nivel: Level up to increase effect duration.

Brazo Azabache.descripcion: Finishing Attacks restore HP, and knockback from enemy attacks is prevented while attacking.
Brazo Azabache.subir_nivel: Level up to increase restoration amount.

Símbolo de Paz.descripcion: Increases your PU/PC Meter at the start of battle.
Símbolo de Paz.subir_nivel: Level up to increase charge amount.

Forma Muscular.descripcion: Activating PU/PC restores HP and grants knockback resistance while active.
Forma Muscular.subir_nivel: Level up to increase restoration amount.

Reabastecimiento Veloz.descripcion: For a set time after battle starts, reduces the time needed to use GP Recovery Items.
Reabastecimiento Veloz.subir_nivel: Level up to increase effect duration.

Golpe de Venganza.descripcion: Increases your Attack Power for a set time when your Guard breaks.
Golpe de Venganza.subir_nivel: Level up to increase effect duration.

Fragilización.descripcion: The duration time on lower levels is stil enough to take value from the tuning and the absence of the cooldown makes it even better choice for non-PUR costumes.
Fragilización.subir_nivel: Level up to increase effect duration.

Hiper Regeneración.descripcion: Breaking an opponent's Guard gradually restores GP and HP for a limited time.
Hiper Regeneración.subir_nivel: Level up to increase effect duration.

Impulso de Recarga de Ataque Especial.descripcion: Increases your Special Action Reload Speed for a set time after downing an opponent.
Impulso de Recarga de Ataque Especial.subir_nivel: Level up to increase effect duration.

Técnica de Venganza.descripcion: Increases your Reload Speed for a set time when your Guard breaks.
Técnica de Venganza.subir_nivel: Level up to increase effect duration.

Auto-Revive Veloz.descripcion: Reduces your recovery time from DOWNED state.
Auto-Revive Veloz.subir_nivel: Level up to reduce even further.

Vampiro de HP.descripcion: Restores your HP when you down an opponent.
Vampiro de HP.subir_nivel: Level up to increase restoration amount.

Vampiro de GP.descripcion: Restores your GP when you down an opponent.
Vampiro de GP.subir_nivel: Level up to increase restoration amount.

PU Potenciado.descripcion: Increases Attack Power of your PU/PC attack, but reduces its duration.
PU Potenciado.subir_nivel: Level up to increase PU/PC active duration.

Quemadura Total.subir_nivel: Level up to increase effect duration.

Cuasi-Permeación.descripcion: Makes you invincible for a set time after battle starts. Effect ends if you attempt to attack.
Cuasi-Permeación.subir_nivel: Level up to increase effect duration.

Permeación Crítica.descripcion: This special tune skill provides you with 7 seconds of safety from enemies’ attacks when your shields break. In this state, you can still sprint and drink heals, but any quirk or special action you use will cancel this state early.
Permeación Crítica.subir_nivel: Level up to increase effect duration.

Salto Espiral.descripcion: This Special Tuning Skill increases your jump height significantly, allowing you to occupy highgrounds easier and catch your opponents by surprise. It may be used in a combination with wall runner, but usually people choose Space Hop over Wall Runner, if their character can benefit from air time effectively and vice versa.
Salto Espiral.subir_nivel: Level up to increase effect duration.

Fortuna Retorcida.descripcion: When using a Team Recovery Item, there is a chance the item will not be consumed.
Fortuna Retorcida.subir_nivel: Activation chance increases upon leveling up.

Manifestación de Habilidad.descripcion: Increases active duration of abilities when using a Quirk Card.
Manifestación de Habilidad.subir_nivel: Level up to increase effect duration.

Revivir Reforzado.descripcion: Restores GP of allies you revive.
Revivir Reforzado.subir_nivel: Level up to increase restoration amount.

Rechazo PU.descripcion: When activating PU/PC, any launched opponent takes damage.

Duplicación de Cartas.descripcion: At the start of the match, double the amount of ability cards you receive from the enemies you downed. This tune helps to build your levels faster, and works especially good  for players who love early aggression.
Duplicación de Cartas.subir_nivel: Level up to increase effect duration.

Magia de Compresión.descripcion: Compression magic is not a good tuning overall, but on non-PUR costumes it has so little competition that it becomes remotely viable. Having a cople of free inventory slots may come in a clutch.
Magia de Compresión.subir_nivel: Level up to increase even further.

Percepción.descripcion: Allows you to see the location of opponents hit by your melee attacks for a set time.
Percepción.subir_nivel: Level up to increase effect duration.

Viento Extra.descripcion: Even though you are going to have a substential cooldown lastng for about half a minute, you will still be able to recieve from approximatemy 30-50% PU Charge essentially for free.
Viento Extra.subir_nivel: Level up to reduce activation time.

Disposición Fraterna.descripcion: Increases your Defense for a set time after landing a melee attack on an opponent.
Disposición Fraterna.subir_nivel: Level up to reduce activation time.

Puño de Hierro.descripcion: Landing a melee attack boosts Attack Power for a short time.
Puño de Hierro.subir_nivel: Level up to reduce activation time.

Asalto de Venganza.descripcion: Increases your Defense for a set time when your Guard breaks.
Asalto de Venganza.subir_nivel: Level up to increase effect duration.

Apoyo de Venganza.descripcion: Restores HP of nearby allies for a set time when your Guard breaks.
Apoyo de Venganza.subir_nivel: Level up to increase effect duration.

Protección Divina.descripcion: Significantly faster airdrop opening may be huge since a lot of large boxes are essentially uncontested. It helps extracting res cards in late game and significantly boosts your team economy.
Protección Divina.subir_nivel: Level up to increase effect duration.

Curación de Distorsión.descripcion: For a set time after battle starts, using HP Recovery Items also restores a bit of HP for nearby allies.
Curación de Distorsión.subir_nivel: Level up to increase effect duration.

Fixer.descripcion: Boosts the effects of the Tuning Ability in the same column as the equipped slot.
Fixer.subir_nivel: Level up to increase the effect.

Golpe de Trance.descripcion: Landing a melee attack puts the enemy in a brainwashed state for a set time.
Golpe de Trance.subir_nivel: Level up to reduce activation time.

Voz PU Atronadora.descripcion: Stuns nearby opponents with a thunderous sound when using your PU/PC.
Voz PU Atronadora.subir_nivel: Level up to increase effect duration.

Recarga Rápida.descripcion: Downing an opponent with Quirk α accelerates its reload for a limited time.
Recarga Rápida.subir_nivel: Level up to increase effect duration.

Fundamento de la Paz.descripcion: Rescue or threaten civilians, or rescue allies to level up your Quirks.
Fundamento de la Paz.subir_nivel: Level up to reduce the activation requirement.

Liberación del Factor Peculiar.descripcion: This special tuning increases the reload speed of all your abilities significantly, when you break the guard of your opponent. Since the duration of the effect is fixed, it's still relatively good, even with bigger cooldown.
Liberación del Factor Peculiar.subir_nivel: Level up to reduce activation time.

Aceleración.descripcion: At the start of the match reduces time to consume GP potions for 30%. This effect also applies to team GP drinks, but not Full Support Drinks.
Aceleración.subir_nivel: Level up to reduce activation time.

Reducción de área de la Estrella y la Ra.descripcion: Reduces damage received outside the Safe Area for a set time after battle starts.
Reducción de área de la Estrella y la Ra.subir_nivel: Level up to increase effect duration.

Aniquilación.descripcion: When you take DOWN an opponent, the positions of that opponent's allies are revealed for a set time.
Aniquilación.subir_nivel: Level up to increase effect time.

Alboroto Explosivo.descripcion: If you take DOWN an opponent while GP is full, a Team Enhancement Kit appears when that opponent is K.O.'d.
Alboroto Explosivo.subir_nivel: Leveling up increases the maximum number of activations.
